from scipy.optimize import least_squares
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
y=-sigma
def fit(f,p0,name):
    best=None
    for s in range(40):
        rng=np.random.default_rng(s)
        x0=np.array(p0)*np.exp(rng.normal(0,0.8,len(p0)))*(1 if s else 1)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, x0, max_nfev=4000)
            if np.isfinite(r.cost) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
        except Exception: pass
    if best is None: print(name,"fail"); return
    print(name, "nmse %.3e"%(np.mean((f(best.x)-y)**2)/np.var(y)), np.round(best.x,4))
